svg.title: How MagLock is put together
svg.desc: Phone or desktop: Flutter app (Door cards, lock-all, an auto-lock timer, an activity log and an optional PIN.) Then: Home network: HTTP over Wi-Fi (The app polls /status every two seconds and posts /lock and /unlock. No vendor cloud.) Then: Controller: ESP32 firmware (Arduino C++. Drives two relays and runs the auto-lock countdown.) Then: Hardware: Two magnetic locks (One relay each.); ESP32-CAM (A camera feed for the door.)
